info.description: Plant your beetles, pocket the berries, push your borders — outwit the Wildwood as the clans collide!
info.ruleText:
Setup

  • The start player claims a starting grove and marks it with their color.
  • At the 4 adjacent burrows they place 3 / 2 / 1 beetles; the 4th stays empty.
  • Others follow clockwise, same way.

Concepts

  • Grove: 21 / 18 / 15 / 9 in play for 5 / 4 / 3 / 2 players. Each grove is ringed by 4 burrows. Two groves are adjacent if they share 2 burrows.
  • Realm: all groves in your color (can be non-contiguous). Starts as your grove.
  • Thicket: 7 regions of 3 groves, each draped in a translucent dark haze. Every thicket holds 2 berries and can be foraged from any of its groves. Refilled to 2 each round.
  • Beetles: placed only at burrows; grant influence in adjacent groves. One color per burrow — clear enemy beetles first. Removed beetles return to supply.
  • Claim: placing a figure outside your realm triggers a claim. You must always keep ≥1 grove; never place in another player's last grove.

Round (play 5 rounds)

Each round, every player has 3 scouts (simple actions) and 1 matriarch (stronger action) available.

At the start of each round, each player secretly chooses one of 3 Matriarchs.

Then, players take turns clockwise; each turn place your secret Matriarch or a Scout, inside your realm or adjacent to it (never further).


Scout — inside your realm

Perform two actions (repeats allowed except Build a Den):

  • Forage: take a berry from this grove's thicket (if any remain).
  • Rally a Beetle: place a beetle at a burrow here, or remove an enemy beetle here. No beetle in supply? Take one from another burrow.
  • Build a Den: requires a stash tile present, another of your figures already placed here this round, and no existing den here. Place a den, take a stash tile, gain its bonus immediately.
    • Berry: take 1 berry from the supply.
    • Victory point: the tile scores 1 extra VP.
    • Place beetle: place a beetle at one of your burrows or any free burrow on the board.
    • Remove beetle: remove an enemy beetle from any burrow.

Scout — outside your realm

Spend ≥1 berry; for each, perform Rally a Beetle. Then claim. No berries spent = can't place here. Forage and Build a Den are realm-only.


Matriarch

  • Stewardship (inside realm): perform 5 actions (Forage / Rally / Build a Den).
  • Payoff (outside realm): Rally a Beetle 4×, then claim.
  • Raid (outside realm): pick a burrow, remove all enemy beetles, place 2 of yours, then claim.

Claiming

Influence = your beetles at the 4 adjacent burrows + your figures in the grove (Matriarch counts double). If strictly higher than every rival's influence there, you take the grove — it turns your color. Destroy any enemy den there and keep the tile as a trophy (1 VP). Equal or lower = nothing happens.


End of Round — Quests

After all 4 figures (1 Matriarch, 3 Scouts) are placed, each player may score one quest by adding the current round's number to their score:

  • Most groves · most beetles at one burrow · most burrows with beetles · most dens · most berries.

Ties = no one scores that quest. Each quest scorable once per game.


Then: remove all figures (beetles stay), refill thickets to 2 berries, choose a new Matriarch. Next player clockwise becomes start player.


Game End (after round 5)

  • Trophies: 1 pt each.
  • Quests: Each scores pts equal to the round in which it was scored.
  • Hoards (same-type stash tiles): 1 / 3 / 6 / 10 pts for 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 tiles. +1 pt per tile with a VP symbol.

Most points wins. Tie → most quest points; still tied → draw.
info.helpText:
Getting Started

  1. Seat all players and press Setup. The start player is determined automatically.

Claiming Starting Regions

  1. Going clockwise, each player claims a grey flaged starting region of their choice:
    • Drag and drop your discs (beetles) from your player area onto the white circles (burrows) of your chosen region (grove) on the board.
    • Click that region so it takes on your player color and becomes your realm.

Choosing Your Matriarch

  1. Press Choose Matriarch to select the Matriarch you want to play this round.
    • Afterwards, every player should have only 4 "cards" left in hand — shown next to the player name on the left.

Playing a Turn

  1. Going clockwise, each player moves one "card" from their hand (located between the board and the player area) onto a region on the board, and resolves its effect completely.
    • There is no "end turn" button — completing your card's effect passes play to the next player.
    • Note: Dens are created automatically.
    • Stashes (squares with solid lines) you take and trophies (squares with dashed lines) you capture must be dragged into the white bar in your player area.

Berries

  1. To collect a berry, simply drag it into your player area. The counter next to your player name (top right) shows your current berry total.
    • To spend a berry, click the counter once.
    • To gain a berry from an effect, double-click the counter.

End of Round

  1. Score your round quests by clicking the emblems in your player area.
  2. Once all quests are scored, press New Round. The start player rotates clockwise each new round. Continue again from step 3.

On-Board Help

  • Player aids for the Scout and Matriarch effects, plus scoring hints, are printed on the board.
  • The round clock sits in the center of the board.
  • Points are tallied automatically throughout the game.
